column1: ## The window thread's bare sites: the inventory the lint's arrival shrinks to nothing (A2a; thread-door note
## One row per (crate, cfg arm, item, vocabulary entry): a site of an entry of `window_waits.tsv`'s `# vocabulary`
## in the product (bt-app and every first-party package it depends on; libraries and the `folio` binary; test code,
## build scripts, examples, development binaries and `vendor/` out), outside the body of a registered door function
## (a function taking a `WaitToken` of a `# doors` line), with the number of such sites in that item. The reading is
## cfg-blind: a Windows arm and its macOS twin are two rows. `arm` is the `cfg` the item stands on, or `-`.
## Held equal to the code by `hang_watch::window_waits_tests::every_bare_site_is_a_row_and_every_row_a_site`, which
## says how a site is recognised. This file only shrinks: a row goes when its site goes through a door (A2b-A2d); no
## ticket adds one. At A2e the file is proven empty and deleted, and the lint takes its place.
